_comment_buildCommand: Copies the WHOLE dashboard dir, not a hand-listed subset. The old list was index.html + app.js + themes.css only, so sw.js and push.js had silently never shipped, and every icon/manifest/og asset added later would have 404'd in production while working perfectly in local dev. The one deliberate exclusion is app.html: a stale duplicate shell that predates the sign-in gate, so serving it would expose an UNGATED-looking copy of the terminal at /app.html. It is removed after the copy rather than left out of it, so the wholesale copy stays self-maintaining for every future asset.
buildCommand: mkdir -p public && cp -r dashboard/. public/ && rm -f public/app.html && cp -r state public/state && printf '' > public/.nojekyll

headers._comment: Declared AFTER the catch-all so it overrides it for static brand art. must-revalidate on every image meant a conditional request per icon per page view, for files that change maybe once a year. Not `immutable` — these filenames are unhashed, so a genuine logo change must still be able to propagate within a day.
